error.invalid_auth: The TMDB access token is invalid.
error.not_authorized: The request has not been authorized on TMDB yet.

abort.already_configured: This TMDB account is already configured.
abort.missing_auth_data: Authentication data was lost. Start setup again.

data.use_profile_language: Use TMDB profile language and region

data_description.region: TMDB region code, for example SE. Re-open options after changing region to refresh the provider list.
data_description.providers: Your subscribed services. This selection is used for discovery and relevance only; title attributes still expose all streaming providers returned by TMDB for the selected region.
data_description.min_rating: Minimum rating for automatic movie discovery.
data_description.min_votes: Minimum vote count for automatic movie discovery.
data_description.discovery_limit: Maximum number of automatically discovered movies exposed by the sensor.
data_description.upcoming_limit: How many globally upcoming episodes to expose in the default next-up sensor.
data_description.use_profile_language: Use the primary language and country returned by your TMDB account. Disable this to use the manual Language and Region fields below.
data_description.fallback_language: Used when translated metadata is missing, for example en-US. TMDB has a fallback-language setting on its website, but the public account API does not expose that value, so Media Watch must store it separately.
data_description.discovery_provider_scope: Choose whether TMDB discovery itself searches all providers in the region or only your selected providers.
data_description.discovery_max_pages: How many TMDB result pages to fetch before local filtering. Higher values create a larger candidate pool but increase API requests.
data_description.discovery_include_genres: Comma-separated TMDB genre IDs used directly in the TMDB discover query, e.g. 878,14.
data_description.discovery_exclude_genres: Comma-separated TMDB genre IDs excluded directly in the TMDB discover query.
data_description.discovery_genre_match: Require any or all included genres in the TMDB discover query.

error.cannot_connect: Could not load streaming providers from TMDB.
